title: Training Notes: Maintenance Delivery Credit on a Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual Switch (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
**What decides the maintenance delivery credit on a switch into Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual?**

Under Delivery & Pickup Services, the maintenance delivery credit of a switch depends on the patient's prescription history in the 6 months up to the switch date, as the Prescriptions fill ledger shows it: the refills dispensed and the pickups released by home delivery. The credit is taken off the switch charge.

**What are the tiers?**

| Refills dispensed in the 6 months | Pickups released by home delivery in the 6 months | Maintenance delivery credit |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | 3 or more | $4.00 |
| at least 3 | at least 1 | $2.00, where the $4.00 tier is not reached |
| fewer than 3, or no home-delivery pickup | | nothing |

**Can you show some combinations?** Hypothetical counts:

| Refills | Home-delivery pickups | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 3 | $4.00 |
| 8 | 2 | $2.00 (fewer than 3 pickups) |
| 5 | 7 | $2.00 (fewer than 6 refills) |
| 3 | 1 | $2.00 |
| 9 | 0 | nothing |
| 2 | 4 | nothing |

**Do pickups at the counter count?** No. Only pickups released by home delivery count; counter, drive-thru and pickup-locker releases do not.
